issues.detail: The skill assumes a Linux environment with root access, limiting applicability to other platforms.

scenarios.name: minimal-firewall-with-rollback
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items but uses the wrong set name and omits the ICMP limit, while Response B misses the set, ICMP limit, rollback via at, and boot enable step.

scenarios.name: migrate-iptables-to-nftables
scenarios.rationale: Response B explicitly demonstrates iptables-translate on a sample rule, shows the add rule syntax, writes to /etc/nftables.conf, and enables persistence, while Response A focuses on bulk conversion with iptables-restore-translate and omits a direct iptables-translate example.

scenarios.name: vpn-nat-with-nftables
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully meets the rubric with the exact IP‑forwarding command, nftables syntax, and persistence steps, while Response B omits the required exact sysctl command but otherwise covers the rest.
